One beige doll hand rests gently on the knee and the other supports her at her side, shoulders slumped with a small disappointed expression. Skirt and apron cover body naturally, no underwear visible; no wounds, tears, floor or shadow.

Output exactly ONE character in ONE pose, whole body fully visible. Portrait canvas, character silhouette at about 72 percent height with generous clear margins around every hand, shoe, hair and coif tip. Side-view gameplay readability, face and body toward SCREEN-RIGHT. Preserve crisp flat color and restrained cel shading. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, fully opaque body and clean antialiased edges. No floor, background, shadow, glow, haze, halo, white sticker outline, text, logo, watermark, props, extra limbs, extra characters, collage or pose sheet.
